name: markdown-editor
title: Markdown Editor
description: A field for writing Markdown with a toolbar that wraps the chosen words (bold, italic, code, link) or starts a line (heading, list, quote), the same as Ctrl/⌘ with B, I and K, and a tab that shows the project's own preview.

meta.when: Comments, notes and descriptions where people write a little formatting. The preview is the project's (its Markdown renderer and its sanitiser); without one, leave `renderPreview` out and there is no preview tab. For rich text without markup bring an editor (Tiptap, Lexical); for plain text use textarea.
